games.desc: "Heaven Island VIVE" is an experience designed for the HTC Vive in which you'll explore wonderful places. The inspiration for the environments comes from the book "Origins of Architectural Pleasure" in which the welfare is of primary importance. The game requires the HTC Vive device.

games.name: Beastiarium
games.desc: Beastiarium — погружение в таинственный мир, полный загадок и чудовищ, атмосфера которого будет держать вас в напряжении всю историю. Действие разворачивается в подземном Петербурге начала XX века - спустя 100 лет после нападения чудовищ на планету.

games.name: Cannibals
games.desc: Комедийный хоррор, в котором отец рассказывает своей дочери историю про людоедов, с которыми ему довелось повстречаться в молодости. Рассказ полностью зависит от ваших действий, но дочь устроит далеко не всякое развитие сюжета...

games.name: SWARMRIDERS
games.desc: SWARMRIDERS is a FREE "endless runner"+"twin stick shooter" ARCADE mashup. A "machine gun swarm surfing minigame" made as a bonus content for the UBERMOSH community.

games.name: ChilloutVR
games.desc: ChilloutVR is a social sandbox game enabling players and content creators to create, share and explore content in a massive multiplayer metaverse alone, with friends or anyone around the world. Meet new people and explore virtual worlds together. Playable with and without a VR-Headset.

games.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® IV
games.desc: С тиражом в 6 миллионов проданных копий и беспрецедентным одобрением со стороны фанатов и прессы по всему миру, Civilization Сида Мейера признана одной из самых великих компьютерных игр всех времен. Сейчас Сид Мейер и компания Firaxis Games решили вознести эту невероятно веселую и впечатляющую игру к новым…

games.name: Business Tour - Board Game with Online Multiplayer(大富翁)
games.desc: "Бизнес Тур" - бесплатная настольная онлайн игра. Собирай монополию. Выполняй ежедневные задания, участвуй в соревнованиях среди других игроков, а после выгодно обменивай полученные награды. Покупайте участки и собирайте с них ренту, приведите своих конкурентов к банкротству!

games.name: Axom: Conquest
games.desc: Стройте, расширяйте и защищайте свою крепость в этом roguelite-стратегии в жанре tower defense с элементами базы. Сражайтесь на процедурно генерируемой инопланетной планете, осваивайте сотни строений, улучшений и модификаторов, пока орды, движимые физикой, угрожают уничтожить человечество.

games.name: You Have to Win the Game
games.desc: You Have to Win the Game is a free exploration platformer with a retro 1980s PC aesthetic.

games.name: Infinitum
games.desc: Путешествуйте по космосу. Посещайте планеты. Собирайте ресурсы. Находите артефакты.

games.name: 东方: 月兔狂想曲
games.desc: Rhapsody of the Moon Rabbit is a second player game in Valkyrie Studio. You will operate Reisen Udongein Inaba and Youmu Konpaku,smash the plot of the scientific eccentric.

games.name: The Rake
games.desc: Hunt The Rake in Singleplayer or 2-4 Player Multiplayer using Pistols, Beartraps, SMGs, ARs, Shotguns, Motion Sensors, Trail Cams, and whatever else you can find to survive The Rake while exploring and completing quests in the 2 Campaigns/Maps included (Hells Valley & 2015 Map Remake)

games.name: Crusaders of the Lost Idols
games.desc: Crusaders of the Lost Idols is an idle game of heroic awesomeness! Create a band of fighters to fight monsters, earn gold and create strategies for the perfect formations over multiple campaigns! Upgrade your heroes, collect unique gear, and unlock new Crusaders in regular new events.

games.name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2021
games.desc: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2021 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

games.name: Animalistic
games.desc: Animalistic is a fast-paced, ultraviolent, and stylish indie FPS game where you brutally clear room after room of creepy humanoid animals. Featuring a story-mode and endless wave mode!

games.name: HEX: Shards of Fate
games.desc: HEX: Shards of Fate - новая разновидность цифровой карточной игры, сочетающая в себе классическую ККИ и элементы онлайн РПГ. Создавайте могущественные колоды из более чем 1000 карт и испытывайте свои навыки в битвах с другими игроками.

games.name: Operation: New Earth
games.desc: Operation: New Earth — это насыщенная событиями фантастическая многопользовательская стратегическая игра, где нужно командовать военной базой, чтобы защитить Землю от инопланетного вторжения. Создайте альянс, собирайте ресурсы и открывайте сложные технологии, чтобы повышать уровень базы.

games.name: Hellscreen
games.desc: Use a rearview mirror to fight through a horror-filled hellscape in this Doom-inspired retro-fps. Shoot behind you, detect invisible enemies & never fall victim to enemy traps.Find new weapons, unlock abilities & warp to maps at any time!Objects In Mirror Are Closer Than They Appear!

games.name: Lost Twins 2
games.desc: Очаровательный головоломный платформер, где вы меняете мир, чтобы открыть новые пути. Играйте в одиночку или вдвоём в локальном кооперативе: помогите Бену и Аби исследовать волшебный мир, решать головоломки и найти дорогу домой.

games.name: Hero Zero - Multiplayer RPG
games.desc: Создайте собственного супергероя в забавной, увлекательной, невероятной вселенной, населенной сотнями негодяев, преступников и боссов.

games.name: Joana's Life
games.desc: In a peaceful part of the town, a series of deaths occur, seemingly random at first, but gruesome in their nature. One day, you find an object that doesn't belong in your house. An old, worn-out, stained mirror. You'll come to discover that the simple mirror isn't the only thing that is out of place.

games.name: Siege of Treboulain
games.desc: Defend your magical city from an enemy army in an epic fantasy game of swordfights, political maneuvering, and romance! Will you prove worthy of your crown?

games.name: Eets
games.desc: Eets may have a cute outer-shell, but its Lemmings meets The Incredible Machine gameplay, crazy characters and over 100 increasingly tricky puzzles quickly sucks in even the most seasoned player.

games.name: Move Together
games.desc: Кооперативная игра для 5 игроков! Укладывайте вещи в багажник авто на разных локациях, решая головоломки. Все предметы должны поместиться, чтобы двери закрылись. Ищите секреты, соревнуйтесь на скорость с друзьями или в одиночку и станьте лучшими!

games.name: Elems
games.desc: Elems – это аркадная логическая головоломка, основная цель которой – сбор Осколков Шара Жизни, разбросанных по 32-м уровням в 4-х зонах – Адской, Ледяной, Каменной и Водной.

games.name: 春风 | Spring Breeze
games.desc: Romantic college campus love, would you pick older sister or younger sister as your partner? Carefully choose one in the game and try your best to catch your favorite goddess.

games.name: Fort Boyard
games.desc: Войдите в Форт Боярд и бросьте себе вызов в более чем 10 испытаниях, сочетающих жанры экшен и социальной игры! Выносливость, ловкость и упорство — вот ваши главные козыри для того, чтобы собрать монеты-байяры.

games.name: Total War Battles: KINGDOM
games.desc: The Cross Platform, bite-sized Total War – Easy to pick up, quick-fire strategy gaming sessions where you can expand your realm and fight battles no matter which device you choose.

games.name: Gear Puzzle: the inheritance of grandpa
games.desc: Carl is an ordinary teenager who works in a mechanical factory far from home for a living. To celebrate his sister's birthday, he returned home and met two unkind people. The story began.

games.name: BzzzController
games.desc: BzzzController is a simple program that allows you to turn on vibration on your gamepad and keeps it on even when you minimize the window, in case you need your gamepad to vibrate for whatever reason. BzzzController was tested with an Xbox One controller and can control up to 4 gamepads.

games.name: Zombie Panic! Source
games.desc: Погрузитесь в мир зомби апокалипсиса с Zombie Panic! Source: командным survival-horror шутером от первого лица!

games.name: LET IT DIE
games.desc: Experience all the heart-thumping action with a silky-smooth frame rate and ultra-high resolution. How you make the best of the weapons, armor, and items at your disposal will determine your fate in the ever-changing Tower of Barbs!

games.name: Wholesome Slaughter
games.desc: Wholesome Slaughter is a retro style FPS set in a fantasy world! After stumbling into an unknown dimension, you must fight your way through hordes of the cute and innocent inhabitants of the land.

games.name: Mechaneer Resta's Grand Adventure
games.desc: One day, the robots around town go out of control and start running amok. It's up to Resta and her good friend Curie to identify the source of the disturbance and save everyone!

games.name: NightSpawn
games.desc: NightSpawn is a FREE to PLAY multiplayer horror game where investigators explore cursed locations, complete objectives, and escape supernatural monsters. Play co-op with friends or control the monster in asymmetric multiplayer modes including intense 4v1 hunts and competitive team-based matches.

games.name: Cubic Castles
games.desc: Your blocks, your castle, your world! Build anything you can dream up and explore with other players! Cubic Castles is a mini-MMO that combines the best of block-building and 3D platform action! Create fantastic parkour challenges, explore worlds made by other players, or even make friend!

games.name: Toro
games.desc: TORO, a bullfighting arcade video game where you will be able to challenge the bravest bulls ever digitalized in the most famous bullrings across the world. Become the number one bullfighter, or take control of the bull in special mini games to prove your skills, and teach the bullfighters a lesson!

games.name: LOW VALUE JOB
games.desc: LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job-simulation game where you sort scattered bolts, nuts, and washers by type. Pick up each part, examine it, and classify it accurately. Play solo to steadily raise your score, or compete online with players around the world to test your sorting skills.

games.name: Zombie Defense: The Last Frontier
games.desc: Одиночная и кооперативная игра для 4 игроков, вы - боец подразделения специального назначения, ваша задача - уничтожать волны зомби, занимая удобные позиции и используя тактику

games.name: Clicker Guild
games.desc: Clicker Guild is a beautifully animated free to play clicker, with a special take on the genre by adding randomly generating loot for the characters.

games.name: GUN JAM
games.desc: Gun Jam — это динамичный шутер от первого лица, в котором вы должны стрелять, мчаться и пинать в такт, чтобы выжить. Он включает в себя уникальную механику стрельбы по битам, многожанровый саундтрек, собственную музыку и перестрелки с полчищами врагов в ярком мире.

games.name: Warehouse Simulator
games.desc: Manage your own warehouse and take care of receiving and sending orders. Become an expert handling the forklift and use it to do different tasks with it. Do missions transporting goods to different destinations with your truck.

games.name: Red Rage
games.desc: Red Rage is a gory, wave-based zombie FPS with a unique art variety of maps and unlockable weapons, where the player's objective is to reach the highest score before they die in order to unlock increasingly powerful guns.

games.name: 异化之恶〇Abnormal Treatment
games.desc: Strange events occur at a sanatorium for those with unusual abilities. Follow clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth. What will be released when all secrets are revealed? Goodness? Or… pure ”EVIL”?

games.name: Code 3: Police Response
games.desc: Code 3 is a tactical police based first person shooter developed for the PC made by police and police support personnel.

games.name: Project Cobalt
games.desc: ⚗️ Project Cobalt это игра в жанре экшн и выживания на враждебном острове 🌴. Собирай ресурсы, создавай инструменты, охоться на животных и переживай бури, сражаясь с голодом, болезнями и усталостью и раскрывай мрачную правду неудачного эксперимента.

games.name: New Frontier Days ~Founding Pioneers~
games.desc: "New Frontier Days ~Founding Pioneers~" is a town-building simulation game, where you command your pioneers to colonize a new land.

games.name: Project CARS - Pagani Edition
games.desc: Project CARS - Pagani Edition

games.name: Red Trigger
games.desc: Red Trigger is an FPS Puzzle game inspired by Portal, Antichamber and more. Use a gun that can expand or retract red blocks. The catch? You can only expand three blocks at a time - so you need to manage your energy wisely.

games.name: Deadly Animal Duel
games.desc: Deadly Animal Duel is local multiplayer, friendship wrecking, brawl game. Challenge a friend you don't like to a local duel and make them suffer and experience agony and torment only this game can grant!

games.name: Magnus Positive Phototaxis
games.desc: Magnus Positive Phototaxis is an atmospheric journey through a mysterious world of characters, traces and symbols. The task of the player is to solve the puzzles, using proper combinations of objects, finding them in the environment around him.

games.name: Purgatory II
games.desc: In this indie strategy game, command your mighty legions of hellish creatures! Fight your way through the real world and seek vengeance for those who have wronged you!

games.name: Sky Hunter
games.desc: Sky Hunter является игрой поединка вертолетов типа 3D, управление простое и сражение интерасное жестокое. Макс. поддержать 8 человек сражаться на поле боя. 5 тематических карт отобраны.

games.name: Lost Astronaut
games.desc: Control a spaceship and attempts to land safely on blue platforms. You can move the ship and burn fuel to fire a thruster, attempting to gently land on marked areas. A new scenario is loaded after every successful landing.

games.name: Dragons and Titans
games.desc: Dragons and Titans — это динамичная игра в стиле DOTA с элементами классических RPG. Более 30 уникальных драконов и 30 единиц легендарного оружия. Улучшайте драконов и куйте оружие, наращивая свое могущество.

games.name: Drowned God: Conspiracy of the Ages.
games.desc: The original 90's Myst style Adventure Game featuring pre rendered graphics, intricate puzzle solving and step through exploration, exactly as it was first released in 1996 but with the post launch patches added. 'Extras' include the original pitch document, pre production art and loads more.

games.name: Governance
games.desc: People. Power. Politics. Play as an MP and fight tooth and nail to stay in politics. Will you survive long enough in UK politics to reach the Cabinet... or even become PM? Will the press find out what you did last summer? There's only one way to find out!

games.name: Hunting Unlimited 1
games.desc: Spot your prey quickly then get into position for the ultimate in hunting action! Packed with over 220 missions – including the bonus Master Campaigns – pursuing 5 species of game in 5 rich environments, Hunting Unlimited is the innovative original hit that started a long running series!

games.name: Escape Logan Estate
games.desc: A visit to the Logan Estate leaves a family in pieces. Play as three different family members to explore and solve puzzles to reveal the mystery surrounding the estate.

games.name: FIND KITTENS: The last of cats
games.desc: Исследуйте этот загадочный постапокалиптический мир находя милых кошек и раскрашивайте черное - белые локации цветными красками.

games.name: METAL SLUG DEFENSE
games.desc: "METAL SLUG" возвращается в виде новой стратегической игры на Steam!

games.name: GASP
games.desc: This game takes place in the same universe as our upcoming tittle Secluded; you take control of a lone astronaut that lands on the surface of a planet, miles away from the other members. And it’s your job to meet up with the other astronauts.

games.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
games.desc: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms — это стратегия в мире Dungeons & Dragons, где воители из разных уголков мультивселенной D&D отправляются в грандиозные приключения.

games.name: Failure simulator
games.desc: Waste time like in real life, do absolutely nothing watch your screen while you wonder were did things go wrong in your life. A simulation game that you do nothing just look at your screen. A complete waste of time and money.

games.name: Depression Quest
games.desc: Depression Quest is an interactive fiction game where you play as someone living with depression. You are given a series of everyday life events and have to attempt to manage your illness, relationships, job, and possible treatment.

games.name: The Lost Mythologies
games.desc: The Lost Mythologies is a Chinese styled action game with intense combat. Use various skills to defeat loads of enemies, explore the ruins of the fallen empire and finally face the notorious ancient weapon - the Black Rakshasa.

games.name: Vampire Hunter: Nightrise
games.desc: Ты заперт в готическом замке вампира. Найди потайные ходы и доберись до хозяина замка до наступления Nightrise. Круши мебель на колья, пришпиливай тварей к стенам арбалетом для кольев и береги веру — она даёт тебе силу.

games.name: Realm Royale Reforged
games.desc: Станьте лучшим чемпионом в Realm Royale! Наделите вашего персонажа смертоносными способностями и оружием. Исследуйте волшебный мир верхом и спаситесь от губительного тумана. Вас ждет впечатляющая королевская битва с участием 100 игроков!

games.name: Manager can be Tough!: Case of the Kidnapped Waitress
games.desc: Hack, slash, and blast your way through hordes of beastly enemies and powerful bosses to rescue your beautiful waitress in this sexy 2D Side scrolling action game!

Ролевая игра с нажатием и щелчком, полная головоломок и жестоких врагов. Вы можете решить быть добрым или злым в игре. Ваши решения определят ваше будущее. Используйте свои предметы разумно или понесите последствия. “Пока я думал, что учусь жить, я учился умирать”. - Леонардо да Винчи

games.name: AX:EL - Air XenoDawn
games.desc: Combining the very best of sci-fi and aerial dogfighting gameplay, AX:EL delivers a totally new gaming experience. Create your very own shape-shifting vehicle and dominate both the sky and the ocean.

games.name: Sumire's Secret
games.desc: When Sumire's teacher develops a one-sided obsession with her, her day-to-day becomes a 24/7 horror story without a hero... only victims and villains.

games.name: Edge of Twilight – Return To Glory
games.desc: "Edge of Twilight - Return to Glory" - приключенческая игра от 3 лица в постапокалитическом стимпанковом фэнтэзи сеттинге, которая поведает о мире, разделённом на два измерения: дневное и ночное.

games.name: Epic Battle Fantasy 3
games.desc: Epic Battle Fantasy 3 is a silly turn-based JRPG, full of useless NPCs, rabid cats, childish humor, unreasonably large weapons, anime boobs, and other nonsense. And it's totally free!

games.name: Дорогой Король Величество
games.desc: Dear Princes and Princess, a legendary kingdom awaits your inheritance. Your people eagerly await your wisdom and courage. Yet, this journey is fraught with challenges; obstacles will test your resolve. Do not betray the trust your people have in you. Lead them to true greatness!

games.name: Music Maker Steam Edition
games.desc: Simply create music - with Music Maker 2020. Now free.

games.name: Dragon Nest
games.desc: Dragon Nest is an online action role-playing game that combines the blazingly fast combat and visually stunning attacks of a console game with the epic story and role-playing elements of classic MMORPGs.

games.name: Silent
games.desc: Это другой способ почувствовать эмоцию страха. Во время игры даже малейший звук заставит вас начать игру с самого начала. Пока вы пытаетесь раскрыть загадочное дело, на лесной дороге вы попадаете в аварию. Вы должны найти выход из леса.

games.name: Crush Online
games.desc: Crush Online is a Free-to-Play PVP MMO with MOBA-style combat in a persistent world. Choose between one of three factions and many distinct characters with tons of different weapon setups. CRUSH ONLINE isn’t just a match. It’s WAR!

games.name: Future Proof
games.desc: Quirky, top-down puzzle adventure game. You’re trapped in a 12-minute time loop. Try to save yourself and a small town from destruction from a meteorite. Solve intuitive puzzles, interact with the people of the town, and discover the secrets of the town. Discover the 15 different endings!

games.name: Walking Zombie 2
games.desc: Одиночный шутер про зомби с крутой многоугольной графикой и элементами RPG.

games.name: Victory At Sea Ironclad
games.desc: Victory at Sea Ironclad is the exciting game of naval RTS combat set during the American Civil War. Bringing an epic approach to real time strategy war gaming, search and destroy enemy fleets across an open world sandbox in a desperate attempt to change the course of history.

games.name: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
games.desc: Scholar of the Arcane Arts — это Roguelike ролевой боевик, в котором ваша жизнь полностью зависит от понимания магии. Изучайте заклинания, решайте головоломки, открывайте тайные подземелья и побеждайте жутких существ, чтобы спасти мир от вторжения Пяти измерений магии!

games.name: BTD:BTD
games.desc: Простой однопользовательский тактический шутер высокой сложности.

games.name: Project Breakout
games.desc: Project Breakout это симулятор побега из тюрьмы, в котором ты и до трёх друзей окажетесь за решёткой и попытаетесь выбраться на свободу.Исследуй территорию, тренируй свои характеристики и собирай предметы, чтобы создавать инструменты и оружие для побега.

games.name: Soccer Manager 2017
games.desc: Soccer Manager 2017 - Play for Free, Compete for Real. The most diverse FREE 2 PLAY football management simulator in the world. Take on a top flight club and test your management skills against the best or help a struggling, lower division team fight for glory.

games.name: Horizon Shift
games.desc: Horizon Shift is an explosive wave based single screen shooter with a ton of new ideas and platformer elements. Do what it takes to protect your horizon from the ever encroaching enemy attack!

games.name: The shaved ice shop
games.desc: Уютная хоррор-игра, в которой вы управляете лавкой с колотым льдом. Обслуживайте клиентов, предлагая колотый лед, кофе, молочные коктейли...

games.name: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim
games.desc: At long last, the works of H.P. Lovecraft meet the medium of RPG in a spectacle of light and sound befitting an old western. Only this is set in New England. Meet interesting people! See astounding wonders! Enslave humanity! Go on one date side quest in a game subtitled a dating simulator!

games.name: Long Car Journey - A road trip game
games.desc: Traverse the never-ending desert searching for provisions. Look for fuel, fix the engine, pay attention to the battery, change the turbo charger! Explore abandoned buildings, sell the objects you find, check the condition of your car. Collect provisions and hide them at home!

games.name: 东方冰之勇者记：序章
games.desc: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy Prologue is a fanmade indie game developed by GAMEPULSE.To save the Princess of Misty Lake "Daiyousei", from the evil who took her captive. You must play as the brave Hero of Ice Fairy "Cirno" and face "Remilia Scarlet" of the Kouma Castle

games.name: Anarchy Arcade
games.desc: Turn your entire digital life into a game. AArcade is a 3D desktop that launches shortcuts to absolutely anything you like. Join the anarchy of the persistent online metaverse, or remain in your own private reality. Casual in-game building features, plus hundreds of thousands of addons.

games.name: The Corridor: On Behalf Of The Dead
games.desc: Step into the fractured mind of a killer. Alone and unarmed, uncover evidence inside distorted memories as you solve puzzles and confront the horror inside the psyche of the accused.

games.name: Copa Petrobras de Marcas
games.desc: COPA PETROBRAS DE MARCAS is a 100% free official game simulating the thrill of competing wheel-to-wheel with models from various automakers in some of the main Brazilian race tracks.

games.name: Warfront Defenders
games.desc: The gameplay is inspired by famous last stands from some of history's deadliest conflicts, such as the Second World War and the Sino-Japanese War. A hybrid of Tower Defense and Real-Time Strategy with a lot of replay value.

games.name: Metal War Online: Retribution
games.desc: Fast Online Car Shooter. Unmatched dynamic shooter with a huge selection of futuristic technology! Millions of players.

games.name: OpenTTD
games.desc: OpenTTD - это экономический симулятор, в котором игроки зарабатывают деньги, перевозя пассажиров и грузы с помощью автомобильного, железнодорожного, водного и воздушного транспорта.

games.name: 8/8/88 Needle AL
games.desc: On the ominous date of 8/8/1888, the entire population of Needle, Alabama seemingly vanished, leaving behind only a haunting silence and an eerie sense of dread. A first-person psychological-horror drama.

games.name: Ragnarok Online 2
games.desc: Return to the beautiful and dangerous world of Midgard! Inspired by Norse mythology, the much-anticipated sequel to the groundbreaking Ragnarok Online has arrived! Immerse yourself in the new, but recognizable world of Ragnarok 2.

games.name: MARVEL Puzzle Quest
games.desc: Collect Marvel characters and upgrade your unstoppable squad in this epic Super Hero Puzzle RPG! Fight on the tactical Match-3 board where every move is crucial, and master head-to-head PvP tournaments alongside high-stakes events all year round!

games.name: Cubetractor
games.desc: WINNER: IGF China award for BEST GAME!Cubetractor is a neo-retroesque action-strategy-puzzle hybrid where you defeat enemies through an unconventional cube-pulling, turret-buildling mechanic. The game carries elements of a reverse tower defence and a grounded bullet-hell dodger to deliver a unique gameplay…

games.name: Speedollama
games.desc: Speedollama — это скоростной платформер-шутер, устанавливающий новый стандарт скорости в жанре. Наполненная необычным юмором и ярким пиксельным месивом, эта игра не для слабонервных. Готовы ли вы принять хаос и доказать свои навыки?

games.name: Time of Dragons
games.desc: Это MMO-шутер, в котором вы сражаетесь на драконах, вооруженных ракетами и лазерами!

games.name: The Settlers Online
games.desc: Постройте свое средневековое королевство прямо сейчас в The Settlers Онлайн!

games.name: Medusa's Labyrinth
games.desc: Medusa’s Labyrinth is a very short mythological first-person horror game set in ancient Greece. It takes myths and legends that have stayed with us for over 2000 years and mix them together with modern gameplay. The game let's you explore murky catacombs and follow along a classic, tragic story.

games.name: Black Squad
games.desc: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!

games.name: My Singing Monsters
games.desc: Создайте остров, полный поющих монстров, а затем посмотрите, как ваша песня развивается, когда вы разводите и обновляете счастливых животных-монстров. Создавайте и создавайте уникальные украшения, чтобы ваш мир выглядел так, как вы хотите, а затем делитесь своим творением с друзьями!

games.name: Ocelot Sunrise
games.desc: Die...and then die again in Ocelot Sunrise, the action roguelite with a dark and atmospheric comic art style and extra-galactic weapon combinations! Help is on the way, but can you survive?

games.name: Villagers and Heroes
games.desc: Лучшая 3D MMO-игра! Фэнтезийная RPG со сражениями, лошадьми, ремеслами и домами!

games.name: Creepy Camping
games.desc: Инди-хоррор. Главный герой приезжает в лес на автодоме. Лес окутан тайнами и загадками. Исследуя лес, со временем кемпинг превращается в настоящий кошмар. Герой понимает, что он не один в лесу...

games.name: Multishop Tycoon Deluxe
games.desc: A simplified business model of food selling shop network. Do your best to become the great businessman in the city. Enjoy the game!

games.name: The Protagonist: EX-1
games.desc: You’re a highly trained soldier on a mission to infiltrate an alien space station that goes horribly wrong—find your team and discover the hidden truth. Upgrade, Craft, and Discover technologies, Enhance your character’s skills in this gripping turn-based tactical RPG.

games.name: Vom Drachentöten
games.desc: Ein klassisches Rollenspiel, reduziert auf den Zauber des alten Genres: Wortgewaltige Sprache. Fordernde Kämpfe. Drei, die einen Drachen töten – und was sie dazu führen mag. [German language only]

games.name: Water Festa
games.desc: Water Festa is a top-down shooter inspired by Thailand's Songkran water festival. You play as a mermaid girl, balancing wetness to remain human, dodge water to avoid becoming too wet, but seek it when dry. Expect a casual bullet hell experience as people continuously shower you.

games.name: Anno Online
games.desc: Anno Онлайн – это бесплатная градостроительная игра, которая позволяет заниматься развитием великолепных крупных городов в средневековом антураже.

games.name: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight
games.desc: «Холодное сердце: Звездопад. Снежки» – увлекательная игра-головоломка с 375 уровнями, локальным многопользовательским режимом и потрясающе красивой графикой.

games.name: Argo
games.desc: Окунитесь в головокружительные сражения в этой официальной, самостоятельной и БЕСПЛАТНОЙ версии Arma 3. Argo представляет собой хардкорный тактический шутер от первого лица, в котором вы сражаетесь с противниками на неограниченной местности, где каждый выстрел на вес золота.

games.name: idleBeer
games.desc: Welcome to idleBeer, it have beers and steam trading cards!

games.name: Hypno-Mart
games.desc: A short visual novel about a stylish blonde-dyed part-timer who works the night shift.

games.name: Trenches VR
games.desc: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

games.name: Wacky Burgers
games.desc: Wacky Burgers - это казуальная, милая игра в жанре point-and-click. Вы играете роль владельца бургерной, к которому приходит множество странных покупателей, и вы должны развивать свой магазин, продавая им еду.

games.name: Cabals: Card Blitz
games.desc: Build decks and fight auto-battles.

games.name: Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk
games.desc: Навигация, наблюдение, проникновение. Освободите заложника у торговца оружием, адаптируйтесь к погодным условиям, используйте ночные укрытия. Выбирайте свой стиль - палящее оружие или бесшумный убийца. Ваш выбор, ваше мастерство, ваша игра.

games.name: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
games.desc: ММО-боевик Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis. Станьте воинами ARKS Defenders, исследуйте планету Halpha и победите в эпических сражениях! Дайте волю фантазии в редакторе персонажа и воплотите мечты.

games.name: Monsters sandbox
games.desc: Многопользовательская игра с возможностью подключения по LAN или Internet. Боритесь против монстров в одиночку или совместно с друзьями. Находите оружие и патроны во время игры или купите их в магазине. Разные режимы игры.

games.name: A Winding Path
games.desc: A Winding Path is a hand-drawn adventure game about finding the beauty of the world and enjoying the little things. Explore the atmosphere of ancient caverns, enchanting forests and busy settlements, help colorful characters, find the rain and unveil its magic. The Rainmaker awaits!

games.name: Death Unphased
games.desc: Invent your own path! Phase through walls with your dash and blaze towards the exit. Death Unphased is a short experience fusing precision and puzzle platforming. Speedrun the smartest routes and aim to beat your fastest time in each level.

games.name: Doodle God Blitz
games.desc: Способность творить теперь полностью в твоих руках! В этой захватывающей игре для всех возрастов в твоем распоряжении окажутся огонь, земля, вода и воздух - комбинируй их и получай новые элементы, чтобы построить целую цивилизацию!

games.name: EverQuest II
games.desc: EverQuest® II is a deep fantasy MMORPG with over two decades of content, a thriving world, and ongoing expansions that keep Norrath growing. Create your hero and adventure through a massively rich, ever-evolving universe.

games.name: Kill The Cute
games.desc: Безжалостно уничтожай милых! Выбирай своего бойца, собирай души и создавай разрушительные билды умений. Прокачивайся, приспосабливайся и высвобождай чистый хаос в этом динамичном 2D-экшене!

games.name: I AM RABBIT
games.desc: 3D Flatformer Cute Adventure Rabbit Game Traverse captivating landscapes from forests to cities, seas, skies, and even the moon itself ! Enjoy charming low-polygon graphics ! Overcome challenging traps !

games.name: My Liege
games.desc: As lord of the smallest noble house sworn to your Liege, you must lead your people and family through turmoil. In this choose your own adventure RPG, can you grow your influence while keeping neighbors from taking over thy lands? Pick everything from house name, sigil, and commands for your house!

games.name: Clicker Kingdom
games.desc: Кликай по золоту. Строй королевство. Стань непристойно богатым. Уютный средневековый idle-кликер с 8 гильдиями, 20 зданиями и 315 улучшениями. Вознесение. Престиж. Повтор. Даже твой Twitch-чат может войти в королевство. 50 достижений ждут, Ваше Величество.

games.name: The Dark Stone from Mebara
games.desc: Set in 1924 Massachusetts, take the role of Detective Monroe, Professor Webley, and Boss Pendleton of the Pendleton Agency, all of whom have come to possess an eerie black rock with strange properties.

games.name: Teddy Collector
games.desc: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of teddies to collect.

games.name: LuckCatchers
games.desc: "LuckCatchers" – массовая многопользовательская онлайн игра в мире магии и пара. Стань пиратом, торговцем, перевозчиком или производителем в этом недружелюбном мире, населенном драконами.

games.name: The Battle Of Mahjong
games.desc: You can only find out the fun of playing “Mahjong” by yourself, I'm sure you'll addicted to it. Don’t hesitate, come and join “ THE BATTLE OF MAHJONG”!

games.name: The Pillage
games.desc: A fast paced hack-n-slash arcade game where kidneys are harvested from everyone in your path.

games.name: Mines of Volantis
games.desc: Dig for rare minerals, upgrade your harvester and unlock research to escape from planet Volantis.

games.name: страшная жена качестве HD
games.desc: You wake up in your house but there is a girl here. She said she is your new wife and you are the husband. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with her. Is it some kind of prank? Something is very creepy about her, say hello to your new scary wife!

games.name: The Drain
games.desc: Feed your master before sunrise. Noise gets you killed. Upgrades cost your life. Death means new body parts to try out. And what do you do during the day...? Well, that's another story. The Drain is a hand-drawn action roguelite inspired by campy '80s and '90s horror, with a sparkle of sunshine.

games.name: Двуединое сознание: Враг из ниоткуда Коллекционное Издание
games.desc: Никогда еще наука не была так опасна! Смерть витает в воздухе... Звучит довольно зловеще, не так ли? Помогите детективам раскрыть новое дело!

games.name: CABAL Online
games.desc: The original revolution of action has arrived on Steam. Put your skills to the test in one of the most renowned action-oriented and diverse MMORPG experiences of all time. Play now for free!

games.name: Sunrider: Mask of Arcadius
games.desc: As Captain Kayto Shields, embark on a galactic voyage of heroism and survival. With his home world destroyed and his nation conquered, the inexperienced Captain Shields, and his newly minted vessel, the Sunrider, are left as the only hope against a galactic evil intent on subjugating all sentient life.

games.name: Bloop Reloaded
games.desc: Your favourite chemistry potions puzzler is back in Bloop Reloaded and ready to test the brain cells like never before. Make sure you save as much of the potions as possible. How you do it is up to you!

games.name: ふとんがふっとんだ！with ロケットランチャー
games.desc: Blow away the futon with a rocket launcher! Fly it far, you win.

games.name: Dragon Saga
games.desc: Dragon Saga is a f2p arcade style side scrolling 3D Fantasy MMORPG set in a world of Dragons and magic. Choose one of four classes (Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Archer) and explore a rich world filled with unique monsters. Power up to unlock devastating abilities, hidden combos and hilarious effects.

games.name: とぼとぼリカバリー
games.desc: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

games.name: Bitter Belief
games.desc: Bitter Belief is a small metroidvania game that with a very engaging story provides adventure and drama. Face monsters and challenges as you travel through unknown lands in search of the magic eyes of stone to bring your exorcist father back to life, after having a contact with his spirit.

games.name: Chinese Characters
games.desc: "Chinese characters" is an elimination and puzzle game, put the same three words into the bottom slot to eliminate, eliminate all the words to pass the level, the game should always pay attention to the lower level of the text.

games.name: Gigantic
games.desc: Gigantic – стратегический командный шутер, в котором персонажи сражаются бок о бок с громадными стражами. Лишь смелые и находчивые станут Гигантами!

games.name: Yandere Maid~Love-Crazed Maid~
games.desc: Вы и горничная начинаете совместную жизнь. Однако по мере развития сюжета горничная становится все более и более «яндере». Сможете ли вы сбежать от горничной-яндере и узнать правду о ней? Это немного страшная игра про симпатичную горничную.

games.name: 플라워던전
games.desc: Choose a beautiful hero and grow stronger as you battle through unpredictable dungeons in this pixel art roguelite adventure RPG! Begin your journey into a dungeon filled with hundreds of events, enemies, and hidden secrets...!

games.name: missed messages.
games.desc: ‘goth gf’s iPhone’ airdrops you - accept or decline? A love/horror story about life, death, & memes.

games.name: Critical Damage
games.desc: "Critical Damage"-аркадный экшен, где мы управляем боевым роботом, уничтожая пришельцев на космической станции "Зенит-3".

games.name: Heroine's Quest: The Herald of Ragnarok
games.desc: Героиня должна выстоять против сил мороза и положить конец долгой зиме. Её мощь, магия и хитрость могут стать последней надеждой человечества. Heroine's Quest - гибрид Adventure/RPG в ретро-стиле, передающий атмосферу и дух классических игр.

games.name: CBO TD
games.desc: CBO TD is a build your own maze tower defense. Protect your castle from hordes of mobs with different classes of towers.

games.name: Guns and Robots
games.desc: Guns and Robots is free to play online third person shooter. The game brings robot action with massive customization. Players get cartoony bright 3D graphics in attractive environments and challenge each other in open arenas.

games.name: Eldevin
games.desc: Eldevin is the award winning indie story-driven Free to Play MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game) from Hunted Cow Studios. Join thousands of other players and explore the mystical lands of Eldevin.

games.name: Hounimal
games.desc: 『Hounimal』 is a roguelite command battle RPG where you journey with Hounimal, a reliable companion and your home. Place colorful and powerful furniture to build the best Hounimal!

games.name: Gebub's Adventure
games.desc: Gebub finds himself in a large peaceful world, filled with colorful orbs and many creatures who need his help.

games.name: Cyberia 2: Resurrection
games.desc: Cyberia 2 combines blackout-inducing rail shooter action sequences with puzzle-solving and animated movies.

games.name: Cosmic collapse
games.desc: Лазеры, бластеры, чёрные дыры и огромное множество врагов... Всё это находится в бескрайнем космосе, просторы которого вам предстоит зачистить от недругов!

games.name: BLASK
games.desc: BLASK -— это уникальная игра-головоломка, в которой вы управляете окружающей средой, чтобы поразить все маркеры целей лазерами.

games.name: The Terrible Old Man
games.desc: Experience a bite-sized slice of Lovecraftian horror in this updated version of our cult freeware point and click adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft's classic short story.

games.name: Call of the Abyss
games.desc: Call of the Abyss - карточная rogue-like игра, вдохновленная таким аниме, как Made in Abyss. Вам предстоит пройти долгий путь, спускаясь в бездну. Исследуйте глубины этого мира, побеждайте загадочных врагов и находите необъяснимые вещи.

games.name: Midnight Shift
games.desc: Одна девушка работала на заправке в Висконсине, и во время одной полуночной смены с ней случилось непредвиденное.

games.name: Apotheon Arena
games.desc: Apotheon Arena is the free online-multiplayer complement to the mythic Greek action RPG, Apotheon. Pit your skills with spear and shield against other players in brutal bronze-age combat. Battle across the statuesque arenas of Olympus, depicted with beautiful black-figure pottery artwork.

games.name: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin
games.desc: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state. Over 800 towns to complete including cities like Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay and many, many more.

games.name: Puzzle Pirates
games.desc: Every activity in Puzzle Pirates is a uniquely fun puzzle: be it sailing, gunning, or hauling treasure, your own puzzling skill determines your success!

games.name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Unruly Clockwork Companion
games.desc: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

games.name: Vinterget
games.desc: Покорите вершину горы в этом коротком платформере. Используйте топорик, чтобы цепляться за поверхности, ловко проходя уровень за уровнем. Прорвитесь сквозь опасности заснеженной горы Винтергет.

games.name: Knight's Saga Evil Goblins
games.desc: Knight's Saga: Evil Goblins - захватывающая игра в жанре фэнтези, в мир вторглись злые гоблины, вы вступаете в роль отважного воина, отправившегося в опасное путешествие для их уничтожения. Вас ожидают захватывающие приключения и сражения во имя спасения королевства.

games.name: Space Mergers
games.desc: Space Mergers is a satisfying fast-paced puzzle game that encourages critical thinking. Combine blocks to create combos and gain points, reach the highest score you can! There is over a million different ways to play, enjoy some endless fun.

games.name: Scrapworks Simulator
games.desc: Начинайте как сборщик металлолома в Scrapworks Simulator и двигайтесь к созданию большого производственного цеха. Исследуйте окружающую среду, чтобы найти детали, спрятанные на земле, на фабриках и в заброшенных районах, и соединяйте собранные детали для создания продуктов в своей мастерской.

games.name: Aberoth
games.desc: Aberoth is a fantasy massively multiplayer online role playing game with charming retro graphics and tons of freedom.

games.name: High On Racing
games.desc: High On Racing is an unique Retro Arcade Style Tactical Racing Game that will warp you into the sky to race against the time.

games.name: Armored Warfare
games.desc: Armored Warfare — это free-to-play MMO, где вы можете участвовать во взрывных танковых сражениях вместе с миллионами игроков со всего мира в режиме online.

games.name: POPixel
games.desc: Hey, have you ever dreamed of being fired by a cannon as a bullet man? How about jumping on balloons popping them ?? You can do all this with POPixel. The game where you become one, jumping and popping balloons. Oh, and don't forget to collect the coins !!

games.name: Magic Lantern
games.desc: "Волшебный фонарь VR" — это уютная виртуальная комната для всей семьи, в которой вы можете смотреть любимые сказки, играть, рисовать и весело проводить время. Совершите путешествие в волшебный завораживающий мир!

games.name: Rampage Ragdoll
games.desc: Rampage Ragdoll is a ragdoll fight funny action game. Game Mode:Single Player Mode and Two Players Mode. Single Player Mode：Control the Player1 Ragdoll vs the AI Ragdoll. Two Players Mode: Player1 Ragdoll vs the Player2 Ragdoll. Control:Support keyboard and xbox controller.

games.name: Star Fetchers
games.desc: Пролог к безумному приключению с гангстерами и конспирологическими теориями

games.name: Dirty Wars: September 11
games.desc: Historical indie videogame about the suburbs of the Cold War in South America.

games.name: EverQuest
games.desc: Welcome to EverQuest® - the original fantasy MMORPG. Explore huge worlds, fight challenging foes, and grow your character with friends. Discover why players have quested, grouped, and raided in Norrath for more than two decades.

games.name: Panda Roll
games.desc: Meet Pandara and Mulatta, the heroes who are looking forward to find the mighty Sun Bamboo, in order to cure Mulatta's mother. In this adventure you will control both at the same time, so that you can use their friendship and trust go through all the puzzles and difficulties to achieve their goals.

games.name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
games.desc: Смешная многопользовательская игра Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl приносит праздничное настроение с абсурдным оружием. Соревнуйтесь с друзьями, жарьте их огнеметом и шлепайте гигантской рыбой. Погрузитесь в этот веселый хаос прямо сейчас!

games.name: Hertz
games.desc: Launch into a fierce roguelite action in this top-down twin-stick shooter with bombs! In a robotic world, control Lizzy and their team of unlockable beasty bots in a quest for upgrades. But beware, needed resources are guarded by swarms of Steel Sentinels. Survive them to craft synergistic builds.

games.name: Rhythm Reunion - Indie Dating Sim Visual Novel
games.desc: The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! Take part in this artistically diverse visual novel as you explore the new lives of each of the old band members, all whilst you convince each of them to return to the lime light!

games.name: Falco Tunes
games.desc: Falco Tunes - Весёлая аркада, где вам предстоит собирать ноты, и атаковать ими суровых зверей!

games.name: Destination Sol
games.desc: Отправьтесь в путешествие на космическом корабле по бесшовному открытому миру, сделанному из космоса, планет и звёзд. Ищите для себя новые корабли, новое оборудование, обретайте союзников - всё для того, чтобы победить враждебную силу!

games.name: All Is Dust
games.desc: All Is Dust is a first-person horror game for PC and Oculus Rift. Experience the terror of a dust storm in the 1930s and unravel the mystery surrounding your decaying farm.

games.name: UNSEEN LAND: INTO THE MIST
games.desc: For centuries, Veridia thrived. Now, an otherworldly invader tears rifts, unleashing maddened beasts. In the chaos, you awaken—once a humble farmer and hunter. Take up the sword, wield your power, and save Veridia.

games.name: Assassin Of Goblin
games.desc: Play as warrior and try to beat green goblin in 9 different levels and find captured skulls in this medieval rpg adventure

games.name: Golf Around 2
games.desc: Пришло время поиграть в гольф... 2! Безумный гольф для 16 игроков! Тактически используйте гранаты, оружие и перки, чтобы перемещаться по безумным картам. Повышайте уровень и улучшайте своего персонажа. Играйте на пользовательских картах!

games.name: Corpo Tale
games.desc: You play as Martin, a Senior Test Engineer, working in a Test Department and it is Monday, yes... the dreadful Monday. From the beginning of the game you embark on an epic quest to make sure that things actually start working.PLEASE NOTE THAT THE GAME IS NOT YET AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH!

games.name: Poopy Pooper
games.desc: Poopy Pooper, the premier pooping simulator and a first of a kind FPS (First Pooper Sh*tter)

games.name: DANGEROUS DUELS
games.desc: A local multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Only the fastest guns and the fastest on their feet can win!

games.name: Pretty Girls Panic! PLUS
games.desc: Popular Arcade Game "Pretty Girls Panic!" is back with more power. Expand the area steadily and dodge enemy attacks and avoid capture. There are 40 stages in total. Conquer all stages and Complete the rescue of these Pretty Girls.

games.name: Armored Firestorm
games.desc: Armored Firestorm is an intense top-down shoot'em up action game in a futurist environments. At the controls of your Hovertank, survive against the attack of the machines in the orbital city of the federation.

games.name: Tank Commander: Battlefield
games.desc: Get ready to blow up the tanks, shoot for the enemy tanks and claim victory. Accept your commander missions, firing to kill enemy tanks . You need be a tanks hero to win WW2 Battles.

games.name: Bent Oak Island
games.desc: Bent Oak Island is a 1990's point and click adventure set on a mysterious island! Join twins Archer and Sam as they delve into the secrets of both the island and their own heritage, and maybe save the world!

games.name: The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes
games.desc: "The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes" is a first-person survival horror game where you navigate a maze-like, ever-changing procedurally generated environment. With stealth, speed, and strategy, evade monsters and conserve limited resources to maintain your sanity and escape this nightmarish dimension.

games.name: Super Starship
games.desc: A futuristic sci-fi persistent universe exploration game with one million stars and 18 million planets and moons. Fly your ship to any star and explore its solar system. Claiming stars, planets and moons will make them yours forever - other players will see your discoveries and you will see theirs.

games.name: Аллоды Онлайн
games.desc: Присоединяйтесь к армии поклонников знаменитой отечественной игры! «Аллоды Онлайн» — это современное продолжение легендарной серии русских игр в жанре фэнтези. Игра покорила сердца миллионов игроков, прославившись на родине и за рубежом.

games.name: The Third
games.desc: Двое восстали. Один всё ещё скрывается в тенях. Исследуйте проклятый храм, раскройте древние тайны и выживите в пугающем и захватывающем путешествии среди забытых богов и тьмы.

games.name: Clown House (Palyaço Evi)
games.desc: Freeware horror game with the mise en scène of an old black&white film and unique horror experience.

games.name: Цена свободы. Тайна кукловода.
games.desc: «Цена свободы: Тайна кукловода» — это остросюжетное приключение в жанре поиск предметов.

games.name: Dark Hope: A Puzzle Adventure
games.desc: Dark Hope is a puzzle adventure game set in a steampunk world where electricity started and ended its existence with the light bulb. Towering clockwork puzzles and archaic symbols cover the halls. Strange rifts of light span the hallways.

games.name: DinosaurIsland
games.desc: Авантюрная игра существования и избиения, приключенческие острые летальные искания, варить разные пищи, изготовить оружия, искать ресурсы, наслаждаться приключенческим путешествием. Жить и исследовать в темной сфере, всегда сохранять бдительность.

games.name: Knife Flipping
games.desc: Станьте новым королем ножа, бросающим в нож Перевернутый!

games.name: Book Of Yog Idle RPG 依盖之书
games.desc: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

games.name: Ilum
games.desc: An open-world game in ancient Babylon with elements of action, exploration and city destruction. Archaeologically accurate buildings such as the Tower of Babel and Hanging Gardens. Voice-acted in Akkadian language in a Biblical and Babylonian mythological background.

games.name: Metapilot
games.desc: Ever dreamt of being in the Jetsons, a Top Gun or on an 80s nightdrive with a smooth synthwave soundtrack? Now you can do all at once. In partnership with major airtaxi and aerospace companies, you can now fly the latest airtaxi models before they hit the market around Manhattan AND listen to synth!

games.name: Unknown Signal
games.desc: Unknown Signal - приключенческая 3D-игра. Вы получили загадочный сигнал и вам предстоит узнать что или кто его послал.

games.name: Requiem: Desiderium Mortis
games.desc: Requiem: Desiderium Mortis is a Free-to-Play MMORPG set in a dark distant world where an event known as the "Thanatos Incident" rendered the world almost unlivable. Create your own biological weapon known as a Temperion and experience the horrors that grip Ethergia.

games.name: Velvet Sundown
games.desc: Velvet Sundown is a social multiplayer role-playing game, taking place on a luxury yacht cruising the waters of a fictitious Caribbean state of Balbonia. Embark on a journey full of conspiracies, trickery and secrets where you can never tell a friend from foe.

games.name: Sigils of Elohim
games.desc: Sigils of Elohim is a free mini-game prelude to Croteam’s upcoming first-person puzzler The Talos Principle that challenges players to solve dozens of challenging sigil puzzles under the watchful eye of Elohim.

games.name: TriggerHeart EXELICA ENHANCED
games.desc: "Pull the trigger of your heart once again with new friends!"

games.name: Night Shift at the Gym
games.desc: Ночная смена в спортзале. Каждую ночь одни и те же 3 клиента. Одни и те же разговоры. Одни и те же заказы. Так почему же каждый раз становится страннее? После 4 ночей вы столкнётесь с правдой.

games.name: Crown and Council
games.desc: Crown and Council is a casual strategy game with short game sessions.

games.name: CopperCube 6 Game Engine
games.desc: CopperCube is a full-featured 3D game engine. No programming needed! Create 3D games and apps quickly. Includes terrain editor, low poly modelling tools, 3D models, precreated game AI, effects and more.

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
games.desc: "Synthetik: Арена" - это скоростной шутер в мире будущего, которое не наступит. Окунись в мир ретрофутуризма, освой мощные технологии и пройди многочисленные испытания бога машин Zir. Пусть рефлексы тебя не подведут!

games.name: The Zone
games.desc: Dimitri has a mission: go to an island and disable all the electrical installations to avoid that strange creatures have multiplies and go out.

games.name: Missing Time
games.desc: An inheritance uproots you back to your hometown. Surrounded by mysteries and temptations, which path will you choose? A horror dating visual novel by Fluttering Abyss.

games.name: Chair Spinning Simulator
games.desc: Chair Spinning Simulator is a short quirky game where you have to spin a chair as fast as possible to reach space in under 60 seconds!

games.name: Splice
games.desc: A security job gone wrong. Now you are trapped with something deep inside an underground research bunker, and you are all that is left. Can you overcome your fear in this escape room horror?

games.name: Ошибка_Мальчик.exe (Error_Boy.exe)
games.desc: Из-за ошибки несколько игр смешались вместе! Это 2D bullet hell roguelike игра, в которой вы побеждаете врагов, используя предметы из разных игр вместе с "Error_Boy".

games.name: Journey To The Center Of The Earth
games.desc: You love riddles and to combine logically? You love Jump 'n' Runs? You don't want to fight but you still want a challenge? Then you will love this Journey to the Center of the Earth! Control three adventurers with unique powers at the same time, or guide them individually in this narrative 2D puzzle platformer...

games.name: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
games.desc: Start your own Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria with Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria Simulator!

games.name: MU Legend
games.desc: Following the footsteps of the successful titles MU Online and MU Origin, MU Legend offers an authentic alternative to the dungeon crawler gaming experience. A game with its own unique signature, MU Legend blends the dark fantasy world of an MMO with the richness of hack 'n' slash gaming.

games.name: Warhammer The Horus Heresy: Legions
games.desc: Собери колоду неукротимых космодесантников, чтобы завоевать галактику в жестоких поединках. Вновь переживи события «Ереси Гора» – оригинальной истории в мрачном будущем вселенной Warhammer 40000.

games.name: Mýrdalssandur, Iceland
games.desc: Experience a realistically inspired recreation of iceland's southern coast. Take photos and explore the world at your own pace, become immersed with some of the latest visual tech provided by Unreal Engine 4. *Please note DLC is required for VR!

games.name: Spirit of Adventure
games.desc: "Spirit of Adventure" is a classical 2.5D dungeon crawl RPG game in which you'll take charge of a group of adventurers searching for the next callenge.

games.name: Shillelagh
games.desc: Shillelagh (Shil-lay-lah) is a fast and frantic arena shooter where players are armed with the aura of nature to defend against destructive, undead monsters.

games.name: Valkyrie: Journey To Midgard
games.desc: Dragon Orb has been stolen from Asgard. Valkyrie has been sent down to Midgard to retrieve the lost treasure. The goddess must not only overcome fierce monsters, but also to face a dark conspiracy that will affect all of nine realms.

games.name: Swinging-Man
games.desc: Physics-based arcade game that will leave you in stitches and begging for more. Unleash your 'special web fluid' to swing across the city, defeat neuter drones, and collect adult magazines.

games.name: Eaten by Darkness
games.desc: Fast paced mayhem in a hellish nightmare. Feel the dread of fear lingering nearby and the exhilaration of being chased by demons and undead in this bloody violent horror first person shooter. A detailed Unreal Engine 5 game utilizing advanced Nanite and Niagara graphics.

games.name: Book Travelers: A Victorian Story
games.desc: Can you save literature’s most famous story worlds from ruin?

games.name: Хуа Ся
games.desc: Играет в ролевую игру Huaxia. Боевой режим - это шахматы. Можно собирать ресурсы для производства оружия и реквизитов. Сыграл роль товарища - экспатрианта, выполнявшего задания на заброшенных землях Хуа Ся.

games.name: DOOMSDAY
games.desc: A fast-paced mad science roguelike deckbuilder. Build the ultimate doomsday device with cards, using controlled chaos and cunning play to your advantage. Defeat your puny enemies. Acquire priceless artifacts. Take over the world.

games.name: Bloodwood Reload
games.desc: In a small village in central Europe something is happening, the forest growing around has something different. Its wood is red color, unique in the world. This does not pass unnoticed to the world's largest logging company, the White Wood Company

games.name: Tap Tap Infinity
games.desc: Tap Tap Infinity is a fully 3D incremental RPG. Hire Heroes to fight for you, even with the game closed! Gain unimaginable DPS, mountains of gold, conquer thousands of levels and millions of monsters on your quest to defeat ‘The Master'.

games.name: Aliens: Colonial Marines Collection
games.desc: Вы с друзьями — самые смертельно опасные убийцы в галактике, колониальные морпехи США. От вас требуется не просто выжить, но и уничтожить очаг распространения ксеноморфов.

games.name: Supremacy: Call of War 1942
games.desc: Вторая мировая война: танковые баталии, морские сражения, воздушные схватки. В игре Call of War вы переписываете ход истории! Возглавьте одну из могущественных наций во время второй мировой войны. Завоевывайте регионы, заключайте альянсы и развивайте экономику.

games.name: CRSED: Cuisine Royale
games.desc: CRSED: Cuisine Royale — брутальный ММО-шутер на выживание с реалистичным оружием, элементами кровавой мистики и невероятными сверхспособностями.

games.name: ANARCHY
games.desc: ANARCHY - это игра на выживание и побег. Орда роботов, ловушек и прочего попытается убить вас. Сейчас это одна из самых сложных игр в STEAM.

games.name: Ohayou! Beginner's Japanese
games.desc: Ohayou! Beginner’s Japanese is an educational game that will teach you the basics of Japanese Hiragana and Katakana.

games.name: Neon Racer
games.desc: Endless road, neon lights, palm trees. The game immerses you in the atmosphere of retrowave. Welcome to Neon Racer! Neon Racer is a car simulator game in which you drive along the endless road and avoid other cars.

games.name: Puzzle Dungeon!! Earthmage Erin
games.desc: Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities! In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

games.name: Ludu
games.desc: Ludu (« ash » in breton) is a free adventure game created with RPG Maker 2003.

games.name: Slapshot
games.desc: Slapshot is an online multiplayer game where you and 5 other players play a game of hockey. The game is physics-based, so teamwork and crisp passing are essential to win. Play with your friends or team up with other Slapshot players!

games.name: NO LOVE
games.desc: A hard scifi, fantasy, hand-drawn RPG with a unique original story that’s mainly about the characters and delves into topics regarding the human condition from the perspective of one person, Wallace Lovecraft.

games.name: PROP AND SEEK®
games.desc: Prop and seek is a hide and seek game which up to 32 players take turns to hide or seek. You can be a prop to hide or be a hunter to find all hidden props.

games.name: Geki Yaba Runner
games.desc: Стань неукротимой силой разрушения или сверхбыстрым гномом, чтобы преодолеть главное испытание Geki Yaba. Хватит ли тебе смелости спасти принцессу?

games.name: First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh
games.desc: "First Hero" is a third person hack 'n' slash, based on the epic of Gilgamesh: the holdest in our history. With an enormous strenght, various weapons and combinations you'll face a lot of soldiers, beasts, traps, demons and even the gods, during your quest to become immortal.

games.name: 剑决
games.desc: 3d duel fight support local multiplayer.

games.name: Bus stop in the fog
games.desc: A bus trip is a journey not a destination. You bought your first boat with your savings of the last 5 years and you find yourself stranded on an island in the Bermuda sea. You must take a very scary bus ride to get off the island ... but will the bus take you off the island?

games.name: Sabre Team
games.desc: Sabre Team is an isometric squad-level turn-based infiltration simulation that lets you assemble and take command of a Sabre Team unit of four hand-picked elite S.A.S. agents as they confront delicate and dangerous scenarios involving terrorist threats and hostage situations.

games.name: Am Madness
games.desc: Your Omega protection has been stolen. Attempt to escape the first signs of madness, in a hard, unforgiving, 2D platformer. Inspired by classics such as Manic Miner and Jet Set Willy. Face the darkness, escape the madness.

games.name: House of the Soul
games.desc: Begin a journey of deception and discovery in 'HOUSE OF THE SOUL', a first-person exploration and story based experience. Explore an isolated mansion and descend into its lower levels as you discover the hidden secret project of the obsessive inventor who lives there.

games.name: Champions of Regnum
games.desc: Choose your Realm and engage in the most dynamic player driven battlefield available on any MMO. Fight for the Alsius Empire, protect the woods of Syrtis or avenge the Brotherhood of Ignis.

games.name: Animal Kostume
games.desc: No talk, compadre. It's Animal Kostume time! Follow kroc-boy in his path to overcome a series of difficult levels in this hardcore 2D platformer with a lot of enemies, bullets and surprises.

games.name: Don't Leave
games.desc: Welcome to a mysterious adventure where justice and the supernatural intertwine! Judge Harlan, in his old country cottage, faces a mysterious presence after his mother's sudden departure. Explore justice's limits in this extraordinary tale!

games.name: WARRIORS
games.desc: Warriors — это современный многопользовательский шутер, который сочетает захватывающий реализм с адреналиновым экшеном. Игра разработана для игроков всех уровней и позволяет сражаться с реальными противниками или бросать вызов продвинутым ботам в одиночном режиме. В игре представлено семь игровых режимов

games.name: Subzero Stealth
games.desc: Airdropped into a snowbound village under siege, you’re the lone soldier facing relentless enemies and harsh conditions. Navigate deadly terrain, combat armed foes and destroy critical targets. Master the battlefield where death is ever-present. Will you survive? The challenge awaits.

games.name: Tactical Mind
games.desc: Become a Master of Pawns with your Tactical Mind!

games.name: Tank raid
games.desc: Головокружительный танковый раннер. Проверьте себя на стойкость, участвуя в сражении с танками и авиацией противника. Случайная генерация противников по ходу вашего продвижения сделает каждый новый бой уникальным и непредсказуемым.

games.name: Winter Magic Factory
games.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy your stay in Santa's village in this match-3 adventure.

games.name: Sport Shooter
games.desc: Sport Shooter puts the player in a sprawling open-world shooting ground, set amongst the rolling hills, forests, lakes and rivers of the Northern English countryside, featuring a multitude of shooting sports, from clay pigeons, to timed 3-gun competitions.

games.name: Solitaire Victorian Picnic 2
games.desc: 120 аристократичных раскладов ждут тебя! Посети Викторианскую Англию!

games.name: Nora's AdventurEscape
games.desc: Do you seek an adventure? Maybe an escape from daily struggles? Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and escape rooms.

games.name: Fly to hope
games.desc: Fly to hope is a platformer action game. Use your shotgun and machete to overcome enemies. Fight with strong bosses and collect 3 missing part of your aircraft.

games.name: STARR RINGER
games.desc: Grab the fate of all life in your hands. Blast your way through the cosmos, destroying monstrous cosmic beasts and the space cultists summoning them, on your path to stopping your mother from unleashing the chaos realm upon the universe, in this sci-fi cosmic horror bullet-hell, STARR RINGER.

games.name: Lethal Operation Episode1 Healer Rugittaリーサルオペレーション ルギッタ編
games.desc: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGがあってもいいじゃないか!! …というのがこのゲームのコンセプト。 ブレイクによって敵弾を消すことができ、 レベルと装備で強くなるので、STGが苦手な人でも凶悪弾幕ボスを間違いなく倒せるようになります!

games.name: The House
games.desc: The House is a new first-person horror and psychological game for the computer. Escape the house where it all began, collect items, weapons and level up. Travel between worlds and time to reach your goal. Go discover the dark secrets of the House where it all began!

games.name: Worldcrusher - a survival clicker game
games.desc: Путешествуйте в космосе и скрафтите другие планеты, чтобы восстановить свою родную планету в этой простой ролевой игре-кликере.

games.name: DEAD GET REKT
games.desc: In the shadow-drenched realm where modern warfare intertwines with necromantic horrors, we have conjured an unparalleled adventure. Forge your arsenal from an evolving deck of cards, face legions of the undead delvers, unearth artifacts of might and vanquish the darkness that festers down the Crypt!

games.name: Inspiring Dreams - A Short Adventure Game
games.desc: A story-driven experience about a man who becomes a ghost after a deadly accident. Full of regrets, he will stay alongside his wife, who cannot see him, and protect her all her life from an unknown evil, sharing her best and worst moments. So close yet so far.

games.name: Divine Souls F2P MMO
games.desc: Real-time combat combos, action RPG, and dungeon instances combine beautifully to form Divine Souls. Play alone or form a party with friends and strangers to slice, grab, combo, and clear enemy minions on your way to dungeon bosses.

games.name: Zero-K
games.desc: With 100+ truly unique units, Zero-K is an RTS of freedom and creativity, tempered by a decade of refinement. Sculpt land into a castle and throw invaders off it with a Jugglenaut. Explore a massive campaign, solo or co-op. Hop online for epic 32 player battles or fast paced 1v1, on 100s of maps.

games.name: Complex 629
games.desc: Complex—психологическая играисследование в жанре ужасов действие которой происходит в многоквартирном доме в Исландии. Разгребайте снег голыми руками, чтобы избежать атаков Деда. Общайтесь с многочисленными персонажами, собирая деньги и полезные предметы для перемещения между заснеженными квартирами

games.name: Wake Explorer
games.desc: Explore, map, and survive a vast alien ocean. Upgrade your fleet, follow cryptic orders, and uncover secrets in this atmospheric corporate exploration game.

games.name: Clay Puzzle
games.desc: destroy falling blocks. Shoot, destroy, match, and clear the blocks as they fall... and aim for 100%progress!

games.name: ONLYUP SNOW
games.desc: ONLYUP SNOW — это сложная паркур-игра. Начните путь в снежной и ледяной зоне, затем поднимайтесь по небоскрёбам и сложным платформам, чтобы достичь вершины. Одна ошибка может вернуть вас к началу — терпение, скорость и концентрация будут вашими главными союзниками.

games.name: hilda
games.desc: Be a cow in a beautiful setting with the accompaniment of wonderful music. Walk, eat, sleep, and enjoy freedom limited only by a stone wall. You can also set an alarm if you need to cook eggs or get some work done.

games.name: Trolley Gold
games.desc: Хочешь собрать всё золото мира? Игра “Trolley Gold” дает тебе такую возможность!

games.name: Counter Agents
games.desc: Counter Agents is a spy-themed, head-to-head multiplayer game where your objective is to sneak around guards, steal the briefcase, and make it to an exit point before your opponent!

games.name: Geometry May. I swear it's a nice free game
games.desc: Уверяю, это хороший раннер.

games.name: Battle Command
games.desc: Take control of a futuristic assault tank, dropped by Helicarrier right into the action! With multiple camera views and an array of weaponry, this much-loved ‘command’ game focuses more on outright fighting than the strategic elements of similar retro titles.

games.name: 仙剑奇侠传九野
games.desc: 《仙剑奇侠传：九野》系上海软星自主研发的多平台卡牌游戏，本作适合以下类型的玩家：喜欢“我的回合，抽卡！”的CCG决斗者；愿意体验崭新剧情与世界观的阅读者；怀念历代《仙剑》剧情但是没有太多时间重新通关的老玩家。
dev: 软星科技（上海）有限公司

games.name: Metaverse: Origins
games.desc: Early development open world sandbox survival game with a focus on detail and granularity.

games.name: 生還者日
games.desc: It is a shooting game.

games.name: Земля слишком мала для меня
games.desc: Простая игра TPS. Сильнейший вернулся. Манипулируйте «Самой сильной легендой» и проникните во вражеское подземелье. Конечно, пожалуйста, не забудьте спасти даму!

games.name: NecroNomNomNom: Eldritch Horror Dating
games.desc: Plunge into the depths of sanity and Lovecraftian lore in this Eldritch Horror Dating Visual Novel. Will you find love or madness?

games.name: 孔明锁
games.desc: The game simulates the traditional Kongming lock game, which cleverly meshes the concave and convex parts inside the three-dimensional splicing tool.

games.name: Lethal Operation Episode 3 Lethal Arms of Justice リーサルアームズオブジャスティス
games.desc: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGの最終編。ショットを合成して、いいとこどりのショットも作れる！ シリーズ最強の敵たちに最強の武器やスキルの組み合わせで対抗し、 この物語の真実に辿り着いてください―

games.name: Irrational
games.desc: An emotional story portraying the struggles of anxiety—the paralyzing thoughts and irrational fears. Join Lucy on her journey to find solace, alongside her supportive yet puzzled roommate. A heartfelt narrative delving into the complexities of anxiety and the challenges of empathy.

games.name: Jax: History Repeats Itself
games.desc: Jax: History Repeats Itself is a horror game where you follow the story of Ernel, a young man hired as a security guard, to complete a series of shifts at Jax's Burgers to get a job at JHR Warehouses.

games.name: Shadowtime
games.desc: To exist in the virtual world is to have two bodies, four hands, two hearts. In Shadowtime, a guide to this double world leads you through irreconcilable realities and through the virtual as a place to take shelter.

games.name: The Stepfather Remake
games.desc: Классическое детективное графическое приключение с юмором, тайной и неуклюжими мафиози. Решайте головоломки, общайтесь с незабываемыми персонажами и раскройте, что скрывается за этой обновлённой криминальной историей.

games.name: Luminoso
games.desc: Luminoso is a puzzle game with laser beams. The goal of each puzzle is to make all laser beams hit the receiver pieces of their respective color.

games.name: Echoes of Undeath
games.desc: Echoes of Undeath is an RPG survival action game. Inspired by Dark Souls and Vampire Survivors. Fight endless waves of monsters! Master brutal combat, unlock forbidden powers, prove yourselves by killing Hard Core, Bosses, and survive to learn more about the world and the story of forgotten power.

games.name: Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle
games.desc: A visual novel focusing on the relationship of two girls researching a cabin with a mysterious mirror. Find out more about their past together, what they really mean to each other, and how it will unfold. Can you break their cycle?

games.name: Skyforge
games.desc: Discover a universe of adventure in Skyforge, the sci-fi action MMO brought to you by Innova Co SARL. Explore the breathtaking world of Aelion, become an Immortal, switch between 18+ classes, and master amazing powers to defend the planet from invasion. Play for free today!

games.name: 与你启挚
games.desc: 本作是一款细腻温暖的轻百合向AVG视觉小说。故事围绕着长期遭受校园霸凌、在自卑与孤独中蜷缩的女高中生——夏目萤展开。当她的人生几乎被灰色笼罩时，一次偶然的相遇，让她结识了白铃学园里如光芒般存在的学生会长，早坂葵。这位与她性格截然不同的学姐，不仅以温柔与坚定将她从绝望中打捞，更亲手为她推开了一扇望向新世界的窗。游戏通过精美的CG、动人的音乐与沉浸式的叙事，邀请您一同见证这段关于欺凌、救赎与自我成长的青春物语。您的选择将引导夏目萤走向不同的结局——是延续仰望，还是最终并肩？这段破茧之旅，静候您的开启。

games.name: Rescue Team: Phantom Crisis
games.desc: По улицам отдаются эхом крики, техника внезапно выходит из строя, а в воздухе мелькают призрачные силуэты. Продержитесь до конца, раскройте правду и переживите неведомое… пока оно не поглотило всё.

games.name: King's Table - The Legend of Ragnarok
games.desc: In this modern take on an ancient board game similar to Chess, one side must defend Odin against an onslaught of attackers as he makes his escape to one of the corners of the board. Use sharp strategy and tactics to help Odin reach safety before he is caught defenseless between multiple assailants!

games.name: Light Bearers
games.desc: Light Bearers is a multiplayer asymmetrical hide and seek game that pits a sinister shadow against cute light bears!

games.name: Trivia King
games.desc: Проверьте себя в Trivia King или играйте в режиме Party (до 4 игроков). 8 популярных категорий и тысячи вопросов с вариантами ответа.

games.name: SushiVR
games.desc: SushiVR is a VR game in which the player becomes a general of a sushi restaurant and holds the sushi as the customer wants one after another and provides them quickly.

games.name: Sapper
games.desc: A puzzle game in which you destroy castles with chain reactions of fire, collapses and explosions.

games.name: KANAPOCALYPSE
games.desc: KANAPOCALYPSE is an educative RPG guesser game. Train your Hiragana and Katakana while raiding a city during the apocalypse. Earn money, buy new weapons and keep study/learn more Japanese alphabet.

games.name: Wildlife Match
games.desc: Jungle animals are going missing and Agent Blonde is on the case! Help her and her friend, Professor Fox, get to the bottom of the mystery! Match fun animal shapes, complete missions and face down powerful monsters on your quest to save the jungle!

games.name: Big Fish
games.desc: Explore an underwater dystopian graveyard of giant creatures that once swam the seas. Eat your way to the top of the food chain and grow into a powerful creature of the deep in order to restore an ancient technology and save the ocean from the sunken city's pollution.

games.name: THE NEW CHRONICLES OF NOAH'S ARK
games.desc: Help Noah in this Match3 game to build a great ark capable of housing two of each kind of animal, in order to save them and bring them safely through the flood. It will be a tremendous task, one that sounds impossible to complete.

games.name: SønderDø
games.desc: You have to survive the night until 08:00/8 AM. The only thing you have by your side is your flashlight. It is especially hard to maneuver around the school since the teachers can hear you inside an area.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge
games.desc: Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge - бесплатная коллекционная карточная игра в сеттинге 41-го тысячелетия, в которой главные силы вселенной Warhammer 40,000 сойдутся в динамичных и жестоких карточных схватках.

games.name: Tax Evasion
games.desc: An action filled roguelike, where you climb the floors of the IRS headquarters to reclaim what is rightfully yours... Your money. Take down your enemies. Buy items with their money. And climb the floors. Unlock new characters and abilities to approach this office building in many different ways.

games.name: The Iron Union
games.desc: Greetings tank commander,and welcome to the《The Iron Union》.In this game,you will prove yourself by using your tanks to break though the blockade,and eliminate all your enemy.

games.name: The Banner Saga: Factions
games.desc: The Banner Saga: Factions is the premiere multiplayer role-playing strategy game on PC and Mac. It brings the feeling of beloved tactical games to a high-definition era with gorgeous hand-animated artwork and a degree of depth unprecedented in the realm of free games. Fight, learn, and lead your clan of vikings to…

games.name: Dogs of War Online
games.desc: Dogs Of War Online is a multiplayer tactical game, based on the classic board game "Confrontation". Build your own company of mercenaries from the wide range of units available and challenge thousands of players in intense battles.

games.name: 坦克英雄 TankHero
games.desc: Tank Hero is a third-person 3D game. This game requires players to operate a tank to eliminate enemies along the way and advance to the end in a complex road environment. Facing different environments, choose the right tank to start the challenge!

games.name: Spleef Game
games.desc: Dig the blocks below the opposing player to make him fall... But don't fall yourself! As competitive as fun!

games.name: Iron and Lead
games.desc: Take control of an Abner Jack in this dieselpunk roguelike. Man the guns, deploy powerful defenses, and fight to survive a relentless alien onslaught.

games.name: Jewel Legends: Atlantis
games.desc: In the Match-3 game "Jewel Legends - Atlantis" you have to discover the secrets of Atlantis and repair the magnificent city!
