Build rows of three or more symbols - you will have huge chains built before you know it! Collect ancient artifacts and secret treasures that you can use to build your city.

games.name: Tank vs. Aliens
games.desc: Fight to survive an endless onslaught of aliens, upgrading your tank between levels to keep up with the horde. Death may be inevitable in the aftermath of the invasion, but it is up to you to bring down as many of the these creatures as you can.

games.name: Glusiverse
games.desc: Ayuda a GlusiGlusi en esta aventura para encontrar el remedio a la enfermedad de su maestro.

games.name: Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak
games.desc: In a time of growing unrest and uncertainty, a new threat to humanity emerges - take control of any nation as major outbreaks challenge world order. Global Pandemics and Mysterious Outbreaks will test humanity to the limits.

games.name: RED TREES RAIL. CO.
games.desc: Red Trees Rail Co is a VR Horror Train simulator set in a Redwood Forest. Work a tiny night train by yourself, transporting passengers from town to town.

games.name: HIT
games.desc: HIT is a free, multiplayer, deception-based shooter. Betray your friends and sniff out the Rogue Agent. Hit revolves around deception and espionage. Set in a sleek, 70s-style super-mansion and glazed with a decadent layer of treacherous whimsy, HIT is short, stylish, deceptive, and uproarious fun.

games.name: Drop 4
games.desc: Cause chaos with bombs to stop your opponents from winning as you plan your next move in this classic game with a twist.

games.name: Horror Camp
games.desc: Выживайте в лабиринте ужасов в стиле мультсериалов! Решайте головоломки, собирайте ресурсы и избегайте смертельных ловушек и ужасных монстров. Используйте всё, что найдете, чтобы разблокировать улучшения и повысить свои шансы на выживание. Но будьте осторожны... кто-то наблюдает за вами. Сможете ли вы выбраться…

games.name: Bait Garden
games.desc: Bait Garden — это хоррор от первого лица, в котором вам предстоит косить траву. Продолжайте косить, прячась от «чего-то», что таится в саду.

games.name: Wobble Ops!
games.desc: Wobble Ops! — это увлекательная платформенная игра, основанная на физике, в которую можно играть как в кооперативном режиме, так и в одиночку. Пройдите трассу как можно быстрее и приведите свою команду и свою страну на вершину таблицы лидеров.

games.name: Daemonsgate
games.desc: Experience Imagitec Design’s ambitious and innovative RPG, breathtaking in scope at over 150 hours of play time. Daemonsgate will draw you in with its richly detailed world, fascinating character interactions, and epic story.

games.name: DK Online
games.desc: DK Online, a fantasy-themed classic MMORPG, invites you to combat monsters, engage in intense PvP, and prove your skills by leveling up. You can magically transform your look into stylish characters. Conquer achievements and explore a vast world as a Dragon Knight. Massive rewards await you!

games.name: Dreadnought
games.desc: Командуйте собственными флагманскими кораблями и настраивайте их. Уничтожайте врагов в грозном командном бою. Dreadnought — это free-to-play игра-шутер, которая перенесет вас в центр грандиозных сражений на космических кораблях.

games.name: Lost Daughter
games.desc: Lost Daughter is an open-world action game which tells the story of Sawyer trying to find his daughter.

games.name: Web Spice Purple World
games.desc: На планету снова напали, вы снова используете мемы, побеждаете и все такое, ура. Станьте мастером в борьбе со злом, используйте весь свой арсенал, и покажите, что ваша родная планета стоит того, что бы ее защищать.

games.name: Bikerz
games.desc: Bikerz is a fast-paced, action-packed game where you have only one goal: survive all of the coming levels!

games.name: 放置大魔王
games.desc: Idle Big Devil is a free idle RPG game with 3D graphics. If you are interested in strategy or idle games, you might want to take a look!
dev: HONG KONG SPARK SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED
pub: HONG KONG SPARK SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED

games.name: Vecter
games.desc: Get in your ship, push the throttle to max, and try not to die. Daily leaderboards where your name stays forever if you're good enough. Custom colors, custom music, YouTube in-game. It's free. What are you waiting for?

games.name: The Mystic
games.desc: The Mystic is a dark fantasy, turn-based strategy game. Become a follower of the first gods, gain their favour, overthrow the High King by innovative combat and magic systems and establish harmony. The game offers an exciting campaign full of twists, battles and difficult decisions and multiplayer.

games.name: Gunslingers of the Wasteland vs. The Zombies From Mars
games.desc: Do battle across the American Southwest in this This Third-Person Shooter as you contend with the evil Dr. Arcturis and his legion of undead.

games.name: Taivas
games.desc: Taivas is a mysterious action roguelite set in a world of myth, and a time of magic. The destiny of a Canidae Kingdom rests on the shoulders of a young fox alike boy. His name… Joakim. Use spells and special weapons to explore, destroy and fight your way to the UpWorld, and beyond...

games.name: VR Maze
games.desc: Have you ever experienced VR through a maze? It can bring unparalleled visual effects to the player, and it can also bring the player an immersive maze experience.

games.name: Monkey Hit
games.desc: Go through long levels filled with various enemies and dangers.

games.name: Tactical Vanguard Saga
games.desc: This story-driven, single-player, 2D turn-based strategy RPG in a sci-fi setting tells the story of a child from Earth, Audra, who is inspired by a trendy video game to break special agent Beaufort out of captivity on Mars, against the wishes of their shared enemy; the Space Frontier Colonies.

games.name: Spooky Horror Game
games.desc: A psychedelic horror shooter. A prison, four monsters, and you. Collect items and keys to survive. Don't let them find you.

games.name: Miasma 2: Freedom Uprising
games.desc: Turn-based planning and realtime battles, with a choice-driven story, all set in a dystopian future

games.name: Fear in The Modern House - CH3
games.desc: Face the challenges behind this supposedly cursed residence, solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and find a way to escape this place without getting caught.

games.name: Descension
games.desc: Descension is an OpenWorld Survival Horror Game That features constant new expansions and events. Survive For Six hours in uncharted universes, and get your exploration rewarded with a stronger arsenal!

games.name: Veg out Crew FPS
games.desc: You are Carro, the lone carrot on a mission to take back the Veg out World from all the moldy fruits and vegetables. Make sure your locked and loaded for some fun, old school, retro, shooter action.

games.name: VR Basketball Sweetie
games.desc: Это игра в реальном симуляционном съемке виртуальной реальности, которая может быть обучена спаррирующей роботизированной руке. Чтобы улучшить уровень выстрела. И красивые женщины болеют за вас.

games.name: Disgusting Puzzle
games.desc: Disgusting Puzzle это головоломка предназначенная для лиц старше 18 лет. Игра очень простая, вам нужно собрать картинку, которая состоит из 20 элементов. При удачной сборке появится кнопка с переходом на следующий уровень.

games.name: Minimally Invasive
games.desc: In this VR experience, utilize an assortment of tools with your mechanical arms to tackle environmental surgery puzzles, all while bracing for unexpected dangers.

games.name: Fate Collectors
games.desc: Transform into a magical girl in this RPG experience! Find and recruit your teammates, defeat corrupted humans, and save the world from ultimate despair! Controls: Z/Left click = Select X/Right click = Cancel Arrow Keys/Left click = Movement

games.name: 破月执行-The Broken Moon
games.desc: The Broken Moon Execution is a text-based fast-passing supernatural puzzle game. Game play is diverse, players need to explore through the map, collect various clues to solve the mystery, and gradually understand the truth of the collapse of "Samle" ......

games.name: 反击吧！NPC
games.desc: 一款回合制RPG游戏，可以鼠标点击操控，或者键盘上下左右空格操作，通过打怪升级，买装备变强，路人翻身做主角

games.name: Jim's Nightmare: Chapter 1
games.desc: Go ahead and take on this psychological point and click puzzle adventure. Uncover the truth behind Jim’s shady past, his current mental illness and his peerless journey to vanquish a madman!

games.name: Brain Freeze
games.desc: Detectives Cheese and Chalk are on the case in this story-driven, puzzle noir. Pick a lock, outline a “corpse,” and shoot at flying hell-rats as the plot thickens and twists more sickeningly than gas-station nacho cheese. I’m not crazy. You’re crazy.

games.name: Akhena: Age of Evil
games.desc: Akhena: Age of Evil is an open-world RPG where the player can explore a vast and dangerous world with a rich history rooted in gritty realism and filled with riches to discover. The story and characters are inspired by classic fantasy novels, where morality is nuanced and defined by cultural bias.

games.name: Revelations
games.desc: Revelations is a zombies passion project created solely by me, Brock de Beaubien. It's heavily inspired by bo2 and bo3 zombies.

games.name: Eternal Flame:Romance Dawn
games.desc: A Souls-like action RPG with brutal boss battles and tactical combat mechanics. Face tough enemies, use powerful abilities and survive in a dark world.

games.name: Calm Before the Storm
games.desc: Calm Before the Storm — это ретро-симулятор уборки в японском стиле.

games.name: Ryzom
games.desc: Enter a unique science fantasy MMORPG and dive into a unique organic living world !

games.name: 牛马模拟器
games.desc: 你是一位家境普通的大专毕业生，开局兜里只有三千多，你该如何才能实现财务自由、娶妻生子的梦想呢？一切尽在这款新推出的开放世界模拟经营游戏中。

games.name: Veilscripture AI
games.desc: Veilscripture — Roleplay with characters that are yours. On your machine. No one watching.

games.name: Ball Pool Simulator
games.desc: Ballpool Simulator is a casual physics-based game where thousands of balls roll, bounce, and collide in colorful chaos. Blast them with bombs, trigger chain reactions, and chase high scores. Upgrade power, time, and ball count to create even more explosive fun!

games.name: Stratside
games.desc: Stratside is a Puzzle Defense game where you save planets from a gravity-changing enemy! Place gadgets to attack the intruder! Combine your resources strategically to defeat the enemy before he reaches his goal! DON'T let him press the red button! This game is like the opposite of Lemmings!

games.name: Aftermath Y2K
games.desc: Inspired by such games as Castlevania and Ninja Gaiden; aftermath is a NES styled action platformer. However in Aftermath you play as a dog. You must run, jump, and dodge your way through 8 levels to recover your beloved owner. All the while also trying to fend off thugs, bandits, henchmen, and mutants.

games.name: Rebound Dodgeball Evolved
games.desc: Rebound Dodgeball Evolved is an intense local multiplayer twin-stick sci-fi dodgeball game. An out of control mess of crazed rebounding action! There is nowhere to hide with the top down camera, so you better stay on the move! The game is 2-4 players in a free-for-all deathmatch arena.

games.name: Nibiru Voyage
games.desc: Nibiru Voyage - классическая игра в жанре скроллер с апгрейдами оружия и полчищами вражеских кораблей.

games.name: CosmicBreak Universal
games.desc: CosmicBreak Universal is an MMO action game that lets you play massive battles of up to 30 vs 30 players using customizable robots and humanoids! Create your own original character and aim for victory with your allies!

games.name: Squares
games.desc: Squares is a relaxed multi player game with out any combat and can be played by anyone of any age... meant for 2 or more players

games.name: Egg Rabbit
games.desc: это особая платформа для прыжков, и вы можете контролировать высоту и расстояние прыжка. Вы должны контролировать размер энергии прыжка и точно перейти в нужное место.

games.name: Rushdown Revolt
games.desc: Rushdown Revolt is a platform fighter featuring 12 dazzlingly unique characters and best-in-the-business rollback netcode.

games.name: Hormone Wars
games.desc: Вам нравятся игры в стиле защита башни с элементами стратегии? Не проходите мимо! У нас есть именно то, что вы ищете! Приготовьтесь защитить свое поселение от врагов, используя огромный арсенал башен!

games.name: Outer Space: War Gears
games.desc: A single-player and PvP multiplayer space shooter with hard-science weapons and physics.

games.name: Freon
games.desc: Freon - это кооперативный шутер на двоих, напоминающий старые добрые пиксельные игры. Наслаждайтесь игрой с друзьями или членами семьи.

games.name: Witches of the Fourth Multiplayer
games.desc: Witches of the Fourth 2.0 Is An Online Multiplayer Spell Casting TeamBase FPS Witch Hunt Where You Duel Against Your Friends Using Powerful Spells and Magical Abilities to Collect There Souls The Player With the Most Souls Win Witches of the Fourth is the Battle Between Black Magic and Core Magic

games.name: Vowel Movements
games.desc: In Vowel Movements you race against the clock to group words together into categories. The only catch is that each of the vowels has been replaced by a different vowel. Surely that can’t make things too difficult…

games.name: Warp Dash
games.desc: Dash through rocky terrain in Warp Dash, a fast-paced 3D endless runner! Dodge obstacles, collect coins, and explore mysterious worlds in a stunning sci-fi universe. How far can you go before the void catches you?

games.name: Enzio-Ware
games.desc: Play through 40+ Microgames in Enzio-Ware!In this colorful spin-off of 【Onwards! To the Furthest End!! Go Forth Supreme PLC!!!!】 you will play through the episodes of 8 fascinating characters, both new and returning, and complete microgames to help them out in their daily ongoings.

games.name: DinoLife
games.desc: Hatch Dinos! Upgrade your town! Buy a house! In DinoLife you hatch and tend to many Dinosaurs, upgrade your town and Dinosaur pens all while bettering your relationship with the residents and customising your personal spaces.

games.name: 城市工人模拟器 City Worker Simulator
games.desc: As an ordinary person, you come to a city and start your life. You must take part in work and earn money to buy food, clothing and other items. After your life is stable, you can unlock special items to be competent for higher positions and climb to the highest position in your life.

games.name: Lord of Midchester
games.desc: Take on the unenviable task of managing a small town caught between two powerful city-states in this 2.5D RPG! Rebuild your township, explore dungeons, hire underlings, grow your town's prosperity and catch the attention of powerful potential allies or foes... you decide!

games.name: Winter
games.desc: Winter — это приключенческий экшен от третьего лица в средневековом сеттинге с напряженным геймплеем и захватывающей боевой системой. По пути вы встретите существ, которые бросят вам вызов и попытаются получить вашу силу.Сражайтесь с демонами, преодолевайте препятствия, завершайте историю.

games.name: TUMBLE
games.desc: Online Multiplayer Fun Stunt Racing Game To Play With Your Friends!

games.name: UpWorld - Multiplayer
games.desc: Embark on a breathtaking journey unlike any other in UpWorld. a parkour adventure that will challenge your skills, your heart, and your sense of wonder. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the hero you were born to be?

games.name: JACK STYLER
games.desc: Former FBI agent and fishing enthusiast, faces an alien-zombie apocalypse after a virus escapes from NASA. Determined to rescue his wife, he defies the FBI and embarks alone to confront the threat. An epic rescue mission filled with action and suspense!

games.name: Redacted:Genome
games.desc: Uncover the truth in a city consumed by mutation as you fight, survive, and adapt in this action-driven survival shooter. Play as Levi, a special ops soldier sent into the chaos, where every battle brings you closer to the secrets buried within.

games.name: The Architects of the Universe: The Orphans
games.desc: The Architects of the Universe: The Orphans, is the first release in The Architects of the Universe series. A linear adventure title, with gameplay inspired by classic turn based RPGs and a focus on plot.

games.name: Волна зомби
games.desc: 《Зомби Волна》 - это шутер от третьего лица в стиле мультипликатора с низким полигоном, в котором игрокам нужно защитить милых персонажей мультфильма от вреда, используя богатый выбор оружия и тактику, чтобы бросить вызов врагу и начать захватывающую оборонительную битву.

games.name: Junk Blocks
games.desc: Это расслабляющая игра для снятия головоломки. Игрок должен перетащить квадрат на шахматную доску, заполнить всю строку или целый столбец, чтобы удалить его. Будьте осторожны с « кубиками Junk», которые будут препятствовать вашему процессу и должны быть очищены с помощью комбинации тройного гашения.

games.name: Escape from exit 7 of the theater
games.desc: You're stuck in an infinite loop in the theater. You must escape to exit 7 to open the hidden door. Go forward and find the hidden door.

games.name: Market master Simulator
games.desc: Добро пожаловать в Market Master Simulator! Управляйте своим супермаркетом, производите и продавайте товары, оптимизируйте энергоэффективность. Испытайте свои управленческие навыки, чтобы сделать свой рынок процветающим торговым центром.

games.name: Games of Glory
games.desc: Games of Glory — командный шутер с видом сверху. Сражайтесь вместе со своими друзьями за славу и богатство на эпических межгалактических аренах Синархии!

games.name: Machinery 3
games.desc: Развивайте свои инженерные способности в увлекательной форме! Решая разнообразные головоломки, вы научитесь создавать сложные механизмы и понимать принципы их работы. Каждый уровень – это новый урок, который поможет вам стать настоящим мастером конструирования.

games.name: Море Матрицы
games.desc: Игра в космическую стратегию. Свободно редактируя атрибуты восьми боевых кораблей, ведя свободный бой, получая ресурсы для неограниченного усиления боевых кораблей. С новыми боевыми моделями, типами оружия взаимной сдержанности, чрезвычайно стратегическими.

games.name: SUPER_HASHIGO
games.desc: The controls used during the game are a simple operation with only two keys: "Forward" and "Backward." However, it offers a highly challenging experience. Dodge various gimmicks and aim for the top of "HASHIGO"!

games.name: Botanic Bits
games.desc: Cut, harvest, and unlock robots to achieve your long-awaited retirement in this incremental game WITHOUT PRESTIGE!!!

games.name: Flower Escape
games.desc: A local 2 player leveler game

games.name: Hang Tight
games.desc: Hang Tight is a darkly charming 2D hangman game that tests your word-guessing powers! Step into a grimly whimsical world where each wrong guess inches quirky characters closer to the gallows.

games.name: Thornwood Palace
games.desc: A cute-but-creepy 2D puzzle platformer where you explore the haunted Thornwood Palace in search of your lost brother. Survive traps, animated household horrors, and unravel the mansion's dark secrets in this linear adventure.

games.name: Banished Souls
games.desc: Banished Souls is a chilling paranormal investigation game where every haunting is unpredictable. Explore cursed relics, decipher deadly symbols, and uncover the Room of Death. Only by revealing the ghost’s true identity and banishing it can you survive.

games.name: Capitaland
games.desc: Start by selling lemonade and rise to become the king of the town. Build businesses, earn reputation, play minigames, buy luxury items, and gain boosts by collecting mushrooms.

games.name: Избежание Великого Террора
games.desc: 1937 год, Советский Союз: началась Великая чистка. В роли Зиновьева, Бухарина или Троцкого вы должны избегать беспощадной подозрительности товарища Генерального секретаря. Выживите в пламени Великой чистки до конца и впишите свое имя в историю.

games.name: Evil Thing
games.desc: В глухих лесах стоит полузабытый храм лисы-духа с угасшим благовонием. Я начинающий медиум, умеющий общаться с духами, и стал его новым хранителем. Но это место не чистое: здесь властвует нечистая сила, зловещие сущности подстерегают во тьме. Смогу ли я выжить на этой проклятой земле каждую ночь?

games.name: Thinky Wants To Guess
games.desc: Рисуйте простые наброски и смотрите, сможет ли ИИ угадать, что это. Thinky Wants To Guess — это расслабляющая игра про рисование, где ваша креативность проверяется ИИ, пытающимся понять ваши каракули.

games.name: Last Ember
games.desc: We fused deckbuilding and roguelikes into the ultimate single-player experience. Build a unique deck, summon dinosaurs to crush your enemies, and discover powerful relics to protect the Last Ember.

games.name: Cube Racer
games.desc: Cube Racer is a round based multiplayer racing game with cubes. Every round, all players race against each other to the finish line. Before every round, the players get to build one or more obstacles on the map. In the next round, all players have to pass all the obstacles, which have been built yet.

games.name: Himno
games.desc: Himno is a peaceful, 2D platformer game with an infinite number of beautiful procedurally generated maps. Take a breath, and relax.
